newsitem.title: CANADA: Great Lakes ship engineers on strike - CWB.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes ship engineers on strike - CWB.

text.p: Ship engineers on Great Lakes vessels went on strike at 0800 CST/1400 GMT Thursday, ahead of the April 2 scheduled opening of Thunder Bay port and St. Lawrence Seaway, the Canadian Wheat Board said.

"The strike affects the shipboard engineers," CWB spokeswoman Deanna Allen said. "It affects three Great Lakes shippers. So with the anticipated opening of Thunder Bay being April 2 and our first ship coming in is an Algoma (Central Corp) ship, it could be a problem."
Officials at the Marine Workers' Federation in Halifax, Nova Scotia, were not immediately available for comment.
Allen said the affected carriers were Algoma, Parrish & Heimbecker Ltd and N.M. Paterson & Sons Ltd.
None were immediately available for comment.
An official with ship charterer Winnipeg Charterers Ltd said, "Certainly, it could affect Great Lakes movements if it goes for any length of time,"
